## Security checklist
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, keys or credentials committed (Gitleaks passes)
- [ ] Endpoints enforce authentication, role checks (`@PreAuthorize`) and `tenant_id` / resource ownership
- [ ] User input is validated; no string-concatenated SQL or unsanitised HTML
- [ ] New dependencies reviewed (license, maintenance, known CVEs)
- [ ] Semgrep / Dependency-Check / Trivy findings addressed or suppressed with justification
- [ ] Logs do not contain PII or secrets
- [ ] Commits are signed
